snippet.title: Kentum - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Science, survival, and sarcasm await in sci-fi survival crafting metroidvania Kentum! Explore the unknown, fight formidable foes, build your home base, and have some laughs along the way. Kentum launches on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch on November 6, 2025. Do you have what it takes to survive and thrive in this adventure? Jump into the futuristic dystopian bonanza with a brand new demo available now!

Warp through time and space by wishlisting Kentum and check out the new demo today:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2165140/Kentum/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012026

Find Kentum on:
Twitter: https://x.com/TlonIndustries
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@tlonindustries
Discord: https://discord.gg/ZwR839E8cU
